about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every F-Pace P340 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace P340 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The F‑Pace P340 uses a single engine family across all generations — the AJ300P 3.0L I6 petrol. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: - Your exact engine code (AJ300P) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Jaguar quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
